description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to oversee all aspects of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader committed to fostering a supportive environment for both staff and residents.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of nursing services. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing care policies, managing nursing staff, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient outcomes. This position offers a competitive annual salary of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to quality care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and clinical best practices
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Commitment to providing high-quality patient care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This pivotal role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is highly skilled and our environment is safe for all residents. You will play a key role in shaping our clinical excellence and maintaining the highest standards of care.

In this dynamic position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, fostering continuous learning and professional growth among our nursing team. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and educating staff on best practices to prevent and manage infections. This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting the importance of your expertise and commitment to quality care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development or nursing education
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
